items.title: George "Happy" Schilling Interview, 1957-09-08
items.q: Tony was with the staff band at NBC one time.

ctx.x: Up in New York, they do in Chicago, they have two.

Brooklyn's got a separate local, I know. Yeah. I have to have a book. I don't know what else to come up. I'll tell you the different locals, you know. I vested a lot with Tony Perrani up there. He's still like a little chicken, you know. What is he doing? Is he working with his staff? George, let me tell you. Let me tell you those jazz men around New York, including Miff Mole and people like that. Two nights a week. It was pitiful. Tony was with the staff band at NBC one time. Yeah.
